keyword: how to file for a tax extension

verifications.claim: Form 4868 is submitted electronically or by mail by April 15, 2026 to obtain an extension until October 15, 2026 to file taxes.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'File Form 4868... Taxpayers can file by mail, online with an IRS e-filing partner'; 'An extension gives people until October 15'; 'April 15, 2026'. R6: 'request the extension... by the due date of your return'; 'E-file Form 4868... File a paper Form 4868'. R8: 'submit Form 4868 by the regular due date—typically April 15... moving the deadline... to October 15'.
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm electronic or mail submission of Form 4868 by April 15 for automatic extension to October 15, with 2026 dates matching R1.

verifications.claim: Selecting "Extension" as the reason when paying estimated taxes owed online using IRS Direct Pay automatically files Form 4868.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Pay online and select extension... click on extension as the reason for the payment... no need to file any additional forms'. R6: 'Pay all or part of your estimated income tax due... using IRS Direct Pay... indicate that the payment is for an extension'. R4: 'submit an electronic payment and select Form 4868... or extension, as the payment type. The IRS will process it as an extension automatically'.
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly state selecting 'extension' with IRS Direct Pay or online payment automatically processes as Form 4868 without separate filing.

verifications.claim: A tax extension gives more time to file paperwork but not more time to pay money owed.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'the extension is only for filing a return and not for extra time to pay'. R4: 'an extension to file is not an extension to pay taxes'. R6: 'An extension of time to file is not an extension of time to pay'.
verifications.reasoning: Universal across IRS sources: extension applies only to filing, not payment.

verifications.claim: Taxpayers must estimate and pay what they owe by April 15 to avoid penalties.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'pay taxes due on April 15, 2026, to avoid penalties and interest'. R2: 'You must make a proper estimate of your tax... pay the amount due by the regular due date'. R6: 'Pay all or part of your estimated income tax due... by the due date'.
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly require estimation and payment by April 15 to avoid penalties.

verifications.claim: Form 4868 is automatically approved if filed properly and on time.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Application for Automatic Extension'. R3: 'request an automatic extension'. R6: 'automatic extension of time to file'. R8: 'If filed correctly, this generally provides an automatic six-month extension'.
verifications.reasoning: Form 4868 is consistently described as providing an automatic extension when filed timely and properly.

verifications.claim: Failure to file a return or an extension by the deadline may result in a failure-to-file penalty.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R6: 'request... by the due date... to avoid the penalty for filing late'. R8: 'Failure-to-file penalty: Typically, 5% of unpaid taxes per month'. R9: 'late-filing penalty of up to 5% of the unpaid balance each month'.
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly link missing return or extension deadline to failure-to-file penalty.

verifications.claim: IRS Free File is free software available to everyone regardless of income for filing Form 4868.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Use IRS Free File. All individual filers can use the program to request an automatic extension, regardless of income and at no cost'. R4: 'Individual taxpayers, regardless of income, can request... Use IRS Free File at IRS.gov/freefile'.
verifications.reasoning: IRS sources confirm IRS Free File is free for all incomes to file extensions.

verifications.claim: Extension payments can be made using IRS Direct Pay, debit/credit card, or digital wallet by choosing "Extension" as the payment reason with no separate form required.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R6: 'using IRS Direct Pay... debit or credit card or a digital wallet... indicate that the payment is for an extension'. R1: 'no need to file any additional forms'. R4: 'no need to file Form 4868'.
verifications.reasoning: Exact payment methods and 'extension' selection without separate form confirmed.

verifications.claim: TurboTax can be used to file Form 4868.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R10: 'File Tax Extension for Federal Taxes... TurboTax Easy Tax Extension'; promotes using TurboTax to file extensions.
verifications.reasoning: TurboTax site directly advertises and supports filing Form 4868.

verifications.claim: H&R Block can be used to file Form 4868.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R11: 'Complete IRS Form 4868... H&R Block can help you file an IRS tax extension online... using H&R Block Online'.
verifications.reasoning: H&R Block site explicitly offers to file Form 4868.

verifications.claim: Form 4868 can be mailed to the IRS postmarked by April 15, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Request an extension by mail. File Form 4868'. R6: 'File a paper Form 4868'. R8: 'Mail Form 4868... postmarked by the regular due date of April 15th'.
verifications.reasoning: Mailing with postmark by April 15 confirmed; 2026 date consistent with context.

verifications.claim: Form 4868 requires name, address, Social Security Number or ITIN.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R8: 'Step 1 — Gather identity details: Provide your name, address, and Social Security number (and your spouse’s if filing jointly)'.
verifications.reasoning: Directly lists required identifying information including SSN.

verifications.claim: Form 4868 requires an estimate of tax liability.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'estimate how much tax is owed for the year on the extension form'. R2: 'You must make a proper estimate of your tax for the year'. R8: 'Estimate your total tax liability'.
verifications.reasoning: All sources confirm requirement to estimate tax liability on Form 4868.

verifications.claim: U.S. citizens or residents living outside the US and Puerto Rico get a two-month automatic extension until June 15 to file and pay without filing Form 4868.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R6: 'two extra months (generally until June 15) to file your return and pay any tax due without requesting an extension if... Living outside of the United States and Puerto Rico'.
verifications.reasoning: Exact match for automatic 2-month extension to June 15 for filing and paying, no Form 4868 needed.

verifications.claim: Military personnel on duty outside the US and Puerto Rico receive an automatic two-month extension.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R6: 'two extra months... without requesting an extension if... In military or naval service on duty outside of the United States and Puerto Rico'.
verifications.reasoning: Directly includes military on duty outside US/PR in the automatic 2-month extension.
